hook.opening_quote: Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him.
hook.rationale: Explosive identity reveal ('beggar is revealed to be a Duke') met with Alexander's resolute declaration: 'She married the man... not the title.'

cliffhanger.final_quote: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.
cliffhanger.specific_question: Will Juliana be reduced to nothing by the cold reality that 'paper makes a Duchess'?

selected_promos.situational_summary: A corrupt church authority attempts to nullify a woman's marriage to a newly revealed Duke, prompting her fierce defiance before he coldly reminds her that only legal paper bestows nobility.

hook.opening_quote: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.
hook.rationale: Shocking revelation that the Duke was officially presumed dead by the Crown during the marriage.

cliffhanger.final_quote: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!
cliffhanger.specific_question: How will the High Priest retaliate after Juliana publicly accuses him of acting out of wounded pride?

selected_promos.situational_summary: A corrupt High Priest brandishes an official decree declaring the groom dead to invalidate a wedding, prompting the bride to fiercely defend their love as sacred above church authority.

hook.opening_quote: You married this woman as a nameless beggar...
hook.rationale: Shocking public accusation exposing that the groom married as a 'nameless beggar.'

cliffhanger.final_quote: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.
cliffhanger.specific_question: How will Alexander and Juliana overcome the War Office proclamation recording Alexander as legally dead?

selected_promos.situational_summary: At the chapel altar, a High Priest systematically dismantles a couple's marriage, revealing the groom is legally presumed dead by the Royal War Office.

hook.opening_quote: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.
hook.rationale: Ominous countdown ultimatum: 'Ten days... this county watches you lose her twice.'

cliffhanger.final_quote: Ten days is plenty of time.
cliffhanger.specific_question: What sabotage or scheme does Catherine have planned within the ten days to ensure Juliana's ruin?

selected_promos.situational_summary: Facing an ultimatum from the High Priest and armed guards at the altar, a defiant Duke secures a ten-day reprieve to defend his woman, unaware a smiling bride is already scheming his downfall.

hook.opening_quote: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.
hook.rationale: High Priest's explosive pushback rejecting divine sanction and condemning the marriage as illicit.

cliffhanger.final_quote: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.
cliffhanger.specific_question: Can Alexander find the witnesses to survive the ten-day deadline before Juliana is taken from him forever?
